# Cale AI Workbench 0.24.12 for Windows

Create Song and Local Radio now automatically choose a compatible installed abliterated model for original lyrics. Automatic selection prefers Huihui Qwen 3.5 Abliterated 0.8B, followed by its 2B and 9B variants. Explicit model selections still take precedence. Instrumentals and user-written lyrics skip the lyric writer.

Standalone local AI setup offers **Fast song lyric writer** (about 1.0 GB) and **Song lyric writer** (about 1.9 GB). Existing compatible models can be used immediately.

The playlist explains when the lyric writer declines a request, stops at its output limit or returns too few words. **Add your own lyrics** opens the original settings and focuses the lyrics field. The app also recognizes a previously saved refusal behind the older “did not finish usable lyrics” message.

## Local benchmark

These times cover the lyric writer, including model loading on the first prompt. The models used the same two prompts, sampling seed, context and output limit on one Windows GPU PC. Both prompts required at least 126 words. All three models completed both requests and included the three requested topic terms in each.

| Huihui Qwen 3.5 Abliterated | Explicit rap, cold | Mechanic rap, warm |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 0.8B | 5.94 s | 2.29 s |
| 2B | 7.05 s | 3.29 s |
| 9B | 23.12 s | 14.77 s |

Music rendering and vocal verification run after the lyrics. The timing table covers text generation only.


## Desktop verification

An earlier local writer returned a refusal instead of the requested lyrics. The updated playlist recognized the stored response and offered the original prompt and settings for editing. Continuing the attempt selected the installed abliterated writer. Explicit user-selected models, compatibility checks and the local vocal verification all remain in effect.

On the test PC the 9B writer took 90.71 seconds inside Workbench. The fast 0.8B writer took 13.62 seconds while the GPU renderer warmed up. It returned 276 words for the three-minute track. The final song status was complete. Full job time was 45.83 seconds.

The model routing regression, 24 music lifecycle checks, six setup checks and the hook arrangement regression passed. The Windows production frontend and binary asset checks passed.
